MEETINGS
Experience professional events
ONE OF THE BEST CONFERENCE HOTELS IN GERMANY
14 MEETING ROOMS (30-90SQM) WITH MODERN TECHNOLOGY
FAMOUS HISTORICAL PERSONALITIES HAVE STAYED IN OUR HOTEL
Schloss Lautrach is the perfect place for successful meetings, conferences and seminars in the Allg u region.
As a multi-award-winning conference hotel, Schloss Lautrach offers an inspiring setting for meetings, conferences and incentives. In our fourteen meeting rooms with historical character and modern conference technology, your events will be a unique experience to be remembered for a long time. Our professional event team will help you to plan and execute your event down to the smallest detail.
LEARN MORE SEND REQUEST
Restaurant
Enjoy culinary highlights
Our castle restaurant will enchant you with culinary highlights of the region. Our chef prepares delicious dishes for you with great passion and dedication, using high-quality, seasonal ingredients. The result is a culinary experience that appeals to all of the senses.
EXPERIENCE MORE
Walking on historical paths
Discover the fascinating history of Schloss Lautrach, an 18th-century hunting lodge that has captivated artists, philosophers and scientists such as Nobel Prize winner Albert Einstein. Immerse yourself in the magic of this inspiring place and let yourself be enchanted by its special aura!
EXPERIENCE MORE
Wellness & Fitness
Let the soul sparkle
Treat yourself to a break from everyday life and let yourself be pampered in our wellness area. Here you will find everything you need for relaxation and regeneration, including a sauna, steam bath, experience shower and relaxation room. Our experienced team will be happy to pamper you with a wide range of massages and treatments specially tailored to your individual needs.
EXPERIENCE MORE
EXPERIENCE THE LOWER ALLGAEU
Discover nature and culture
Let yourself be enchanted by the charms of the Unterallg u. You can explore the well-developed Iller bike path with our rental bikes, or alternatively take an exciting hike. Culture lovers will also enjoy the farm museum in Illerbeuren or a trip to Memmingen. Discover all of the possibilities!

Personalised service
We have been coming to Schloss Lautrach for our retreats for many years and are always impressed - especially by the high level of service and the exceptional friendliness of the staff. Our special requests, such as vegan catering, were also catered for 100%. A big compliment and a big thank you to the whole team!
André

We celebrated our wedding there and were completely satisfied! The food in particular was incredibly good, everyone was delighted! The advice and support before and during the celebrations was also excellent. The food was of a high culinary standard, the location with the fantastic castle garden and the excellent rooms were unique. I can recommend Schloss Lautrach as an event location without reservation. Many thanks again.
Brunello

A great castle ambience, and then a top modern, perfectly designed room. Friendly staff, great breakfast, good car park, a fantastic castle park - what more could you want? Our only regret was that we only had one night to enjoy it. More next time!
Detlef

Seminars with a difference
The staff at the Schloss Lautrach are professional, friendly, helpful and absolutely competent. Individual wishes are catered for in order to make your stay more enjoyable. Attention to detail is present in every room. The food is delicious. A feast for the senses.

It was a really great experience to have chosen this marvellous ambience of the castle for our weekend with friends. Extremely friendly staff, whether at the time of booking, check-in/out or the service at the very good breakfast. I can therefore only recommend the Hotel Schloss Lautrach.

History | Schloss Lautrach Hotel GmbH Skip to main content
HISTORY
A journey into the fascinating past of Schloss Lautrach
Book
location Book Offers
10 10. 2026
11 10. 2026
Book
read more
A TIME TRAVEL
Tracing the history of Schloss Lautrach
Experience history with all of your senses in our charming castle hotel, whose origins date back to 1781. The majestic Schloss Lautrach radiates princely charm and elegance to this day. Immerse yourself in the rich past of this impressive estate, which has witnessed numerous events and notable personalities over the centuries.
Lorem ipsum dolor
Hunting lodge and provostry
In 1781, Prince-Abbot of Kempten, Baron Honorius von Schreckenstein, had Schloss Lautrach built as a provostry and hunting lodge within only three years. With its ornate rococo decoration and mansard roof with gable-crowned central risalit, it embodies the splendour of a bygone era.
Lorem ipsum dolor
SCHLOSS LAUTRACH BLOSSOMS
Firmas-Perier builds a theatre in the castle
When Bavaria took over Schloss Lautrach in 1803 in the course of secularisation, a new era began for this magnificent estate. Shortly thereafter, in 1805, it was sold to the French emigrant Count Firmas-Perier, who allowed the castle to continue to flourish.
Under this new owner, the chateau received a magnificent two-story theatre hall in 1825, which was decorated with hand-printed paper wallpaper from the Dufour manufactory in Paris. The ceiling paintings depicted the "Toilet of Venus," while the panoramic wallpaper narrated various scenes from the "Travels of Anthenor." These rare wallpapers are true treasures, decorating the castle with timeless elegance and artistic splendour.
Today, only a few such wall tapestries have been preserved. Apart from Schloss Lautrach, Dufour wallpapers can also be admired in the Metropolitan Museum in New York and Fasanerie Castle near Fulda.
Female educational institution
of higher education
As early as 1838, the castle was used by the visionary educator and Catholic priest Joseph Deybach as a "Female Educational Institution of Higher Education." Here, schoolgirls from Germany and abroad received a comprehensive education and were raised to become self-confident and educated women.
THE GOLDEN ERA
Intellectual and cultural centre at Schloss Lautrach
The true golden age of Schloss Lautrach began in 1921, when the castle was acquired by the brilliant art historian and inventor of the gyrocompass, Hermann Ansch tz-Kaempfe. With tireless passion, he had the property lavishly renovated and donated it to the Ludwig Maximilian University. The castle became an inspiring meeting place for scientists, artists and Nobel Prize winners, who shared their ideas here and shaped the intellectual scene of the early-20th century.
Lorem ipsum dolor
»Paradise! O vexation, that I must already depart!«
None other than Albert Einstein immortalised himself in the guest book of Schloss Lautrach in 1923 with these words. He and Ansch tz-Kaempfe were connected by a lifelong, close friendship.
Albert Einstein
Guest book schloss Lautrach
Ingenious encounters
Personalities such as Albert Einstein, Karl von Frisch, Arnold Sommerfeld, Heinrich Wieland, Wilhelm Wien, Raoul Frank and Olaf Gulbransson met here.
Known as "faculty meetings," these gatherings were famous for their interdisciplinary atmosphere and provided a platform for discussions and the exchange of ideas.
Lorem ipsum dolor
A THANK YOU FROM LOFTY HEIGHTS
LZ 127 Graf Zeppelin
In 1929, the airship LZ 127 Graf Zeppelin crowned its globe-spanning voyage by making a welcoming flight over the majestic Schloss Lautrach. With an unforgettable salute to the inventor of the gyrocompass, Hermann Ansch tz-Kaempfe, it reverently tilted its bow three times. Without this pioneering compass, successful navigation on this historic voyage would not have been possible.
Lorem ipsum dolor
CONTINUATION OF THE TRADITION
Preserving the heritage of Schloss Lautrach
In 1989, the Management Centrum Schloss Lautrach was founded with the aim of preserving the historic estate and developing it into a modern event venue.
During this significant restoration phase, special attention was paid to preserving the historic details and original elegance of the castle. Lovingly preserved elements such as the hand-printed paper wallpaper in the Rococo Theatre Hall and the ornate wall panelling in the Ansch tz-Kaempfe Library were carefully restored to maintain the timeless charm of bygone eras.
At the same time, modern amenities were introduced to provide guests with a comfortable stay. Finally, in October 1993, the Management Centrum Schloss Lautrach was opened.
ATTENTION TO DETAIL
History at your fingertips in four-star garb
Today, Schloss Lautrach is an award-winning four-star hotel that proudly carries on its long tradition of education, meeting and culture.
Amidst the lovingly preserved details and breathtaking architecture, you can literally feel the bygone era and transport yourself back to a time when beauty and elegance were omnipresent.

wikipedia.title: Schloss Lautrach
wikipedia.extract: Schloss Lautrach, auch Neues Schloss Lautrach, ist ein Schloss in Lautrach im schwäbischen Landkreis Unterallgäu, das heute als Tagungsstätte genutzt wird.
